question: Why was the acid value of the macaw palm almond oil evaluated as a heat-transfer fluid higher than every literature value for macaw oil it was compared with?
rendered: The acid value of the macaw palm almond oil evaluated as a heat-transfer fluid (3.44 mg KOH·g−1) was actually lower than the literature values for macaw oil it was compared with (3.49 mg KOH·g−1 by Gonçalves, 12.24 mg of KOH/g by Melo, and 12.8 mg KOH·g−1 by Amaral).
